properties.description: The launch wrapper `.mcp.json` invokes instead of a raw binary. Since 2026-09-12 it serves target/release/reflow2-mcp and never builds it: missing binary is a refusal naming tools/reflow2-rebuild.sh, and a binary older than the source is served behind an unconditional banner. REFLOW2_PROFILE=debug restores the previous content-hash auto-rebuild for the edit-compile loop. All output goes to stderr, because stdout is the JSON-RPC channel.
properties.name: reflow2-mcp-launch.sh
